The release where RoboInvestor's interface becomes our own. Since v0.5.0 (September 19, 2026) the app has moved off the Flowbite component library onto UI primitives owned in `@robosystems/core`, gained its own documentation site and the shared bottom-drawer console, and had its public pages rebuilt around live product demos. The series went out as twenty-five patch releases; this file is the account of it as a whole.

## 🎨 The interface is ours

- **Every component the app renders now comes from `@robosystems/core/ui`,** the UI layer owned in the shared core package, in place of the Flowbite React library. Nothing you see changes: the cutover was gated on full-page screenshots of every routed page in light and dark, on desktop and mobile, against the previous release, and the pages render the same. Your dark-mode choice carries over untouched (#415)
- **The contact form's overlay is translucent again.** It had been solid since the Tailwind v4 upgrade (#415)

## 📚 Docs and the console

- **RoboInvestor docs at roboinvestor.ai/docs.** The product documentation renders on roboinvestor.ai with a sidebar, heading anchors and an "On this page" list, and the app links to it. Two selection bugs found while checking the docs against the app are fixed: Portfolio read the first RoboInvestor graph instead of the selected one, and a shared report opened with the SEC repository selected said it was gone (#334)
- **The console is a drawer at the bottom of every page,** and that drawer is the only way into it. Old `/console` links and bookmarks open it and land on Home (#356)
- **Docs in the user menu and the shared footer,** linking the platform guides (#334)

## 🌐 Public site and research

- **Live demos on the landing page.** The static illustrations are replaced by animated product demos in two lanes: the fund manager first, then public-company research as a lane of its own that needs no fund. The demos run on the runtime shared with the other two sites, so the three no longer drift (#353, #354, #355)
- **Any MCP client, not one.** The public pages pair the knowledge graph with "Claude, ChatGPT, or any MCP client" instead of leading with one vendor (#331)
- **Filer pages render the holon first.** A filing's page and its "open in viewer" link use the complete report, with the Tavi model as the fallback. The server renders a filer page's statements from the file sized for it (#376, #387)
- **Search engines and answer engines.** `/llms.txt` maps the site for language models; new research URLs are announced to IndexNow; the site publishes as RoboSystems by `@id` while keeping RoboInvestor as its name, so search engines see one company and one founder; every signed-in section's own page is kept out of the index; and research pages reach every edge within the hour instead of serving a year-old render to a crawler (#335, #337, #341, #349, #350)
- Console sits with the other on-page links in the top bar (#336), and the repository carries an Apache 2.0 `NOTICE` with the trademark attribution (#352)

## 🐛 Bug fixes

- **The portfolio page fits a phone.** It scrolled 274px sideways on a 390px screen; the holdings table now scrolls inside its own box and the grid can shrink (#339)
- **Adding a security is safe to retry.** A failed position write no longer leaves a second security behind on retry; quantity and cost take plain or US-grouped amounts and refuse ambiguous or negative input instead of booking a rewritten number; a report reloads cleanly after a graph switch (#346)
- **Deployed builds get the production content-security policy.** The list was chosen by request hostname, which a deployed server does not report; it is chosen by environment now (#348)

## 🔒 Hardening

- Report proxy validation and response headers tightened, the report viewer sends its session to the proxy, and client IP attribution behind the CDN is hardened (#345)

## 🔧 Infrastructure

- **`@robosystems/client` 1.17.2 → 2.35.0,** crossing the client's 2.0 line. This app uses the facade clients, which carried across unchanged. **`@robosystems/core` 0.9.5 → 0.19.0,** carrying the console drawer, the demo runtime, the shared footer and, in 0.18, the owned UI layer. **`@robosystems/report-components` 0.7.0 → 0.13.0,** with the fact inspector's "How it was made" and the holon's lineage walk (#332, #338, #340, #342, #343, #344, #347, #351, #360, #368, #377, #386, #388, #389, #391, #393, #394, #395, #396, #397, #398, #403, #404, #407, #408, #415, #416)
- **Flowbite, flowbite-react and the `deepmerge-ts` override they forced are gone** from the dependency tree, and the image no longer copies the generated class list. `npm audit`'s remaining findings are one `minimatch` advisory reached only through the eslint toolchain, dev-only (#415)
- **The app runs on Node 26,** the active LTS since October 28: the image base, the workflows, `engines` and the type definitions move together, and the vitest workers turn off Node's own Web Storage so the browser-style storage the tests use stays jsdom's (#416)
- **Next 16.4.** vitest 4.1 and Vite 8.3; vitest 5 is held until its 5.1 line (#400, #405, #412)
- **A second compute route.** App Runner is closed to new AWS customers, so the deploy workflow offers ECS Express Mode beside it for a fork deploying into a fresh account; App Runner stays the default (#357)
- **Permissions boundaries** on every IAM role the app's stacks create (#378)
- **CI and images:** Docker Hub publishes over OIDC instead of a stored token, base images pull authenticated from ECR Public, the hosted runner image is pinned, and the build's credential scope is narrowed (#359, #361, #364, #365, #366, #367, #375)
- **For forks and self-hosters:** the app requires Node 26 and `@robosystems/core` 0.19.0 or later, and a per-call Flowbite `theme` object has no equivalent; the Modal, Card and Alert primitives accept a partial `theme` merged over the defaults (#415)

## 📦 Deploy notes

- **No API upgrade is required.** Everything this release reads is served by the API already in production.
- **The production image moves to Node 26.** Nothing in the stack changes with it; watch the first run's logs as with any runtime change.
- **No pending CloudFormation changes.** The series added the ECS Express template and the permissions-boundary parameter, and both reached production with the v0.5.x patches.
- **Variables and secrets added during the series,** all already set here: the `ORIGIN_VERIFY_SECRET` repository secret and the `REPORT_BUNDLE_BUCKET` runtime variable (#345), and the `INDEXNOW_KEY` variable (#341). A fork needs all three.
